technical_commentary: LICHSGFIN's monthly chart shows a completed boom-bust cycle, not a live top: a clean Stage-2 markup off the Mar-2023 base (Rs 312) reached an all-time-high spike of Rs 802 in Jul-2024 (Jun-2024 closing high Rs 773, with July's marginal new intraday high closing lower -- a classic upthrust), then broke down hard into a Feb-2025 low of Rs 488 (-39% off the high) as the Choppiness Index rose from a trending ~27-31 in 2023-24 to the mid-50s through the breakdown. The 17 months since have been a genuinely non-trending range between roughly Rs 488-635 (Choppiness Index still mostly 50-64), printing a lower swing high (Rs 608 Jun-2025 fading to Rs 564 Jun-2026) against only a marginal higher low (Rs 495 Mar-2026 vs Rs 488 Feb-2025), price now squeezed within ~3% of the flattening 6-/10-month MAs (Rs 539/542) while the 20-month MA (Rs 556) is still gently rolling over, and volume that ran net-distributive over the past year (down-months 1.3x up-months) only just tilting positive in the last six. This is an immature, unresolved Stage-1 base still fighting supply -- not the stale 'Stage 3 - Topping' label (that top resolved a year ago) -- and needs a monthly close back above the Jun-2025 high of Rs 608 to first suggest a new advance, versus a break of the Rs 488-495 shelf that reopens the downtrend.
